what: Observations the triage readers recorded for a later pass, by batch.

observations.observation: Same-deposit targets that a find already states (F239.C1 -> F239.B1, F510.C1 -> F510.A1) are recorded as target_kind 'find', not 'self'; 'self' is used only where the earlier statement in the same deposit is not a find (F239.C2, F453.C1).
For target_kind deposit/self/external/unlocated the protocol gives no place for the claimed value; each such decision carries a decision-level 'claimed' field (extra to the protocol shape).
The 'claimed' vocabulary has no value for a registered correspondence that disclaims fulfilment (F453.C1); 'partly' was used, and the basis states the disclaimer.

DOI resolution in pointers.json maps a DOI to the first registry deposit whose zenodo_dois list contains it, and those lists include cited DOIs; several resolutions in this batch were wrong (10.5281/zenodo.18141735 -> #87, actually #219; 18148298 -> #229; 18157917 -> #31, actually #244; 18202475 -> #11, actually #283; 18772675 -> #22, actually #513; 18369038 -> #31, actually #1337; 18808402 -> #31, actually #519). Own DOIs were identified from the per_doi titles in alexanarch/data/external-metadata.
#1251 is dated 2026-01-17 but indexes deposits from February 2026 (#513, 2026-02-25; #519, 2026-02-27), so its date is earlier than items it lists.

#510 ('Semantic Physics: The Inward Turn', 2026-02-24), whose writable-layer thesis #513 says the Citrini memo (2026-02-22) proves, is dated after the memo; #22 instead places the prior formalization in the RCF paper (#234, 2026-01-04).
